theme: An open Halloween Saturday in St. Pete, the girls in hand.
greeting: A wide-open Saturday, Dan — nothing on the calendar and the girls with you for Halloween in St. Pete. The only things on the horizon are tomorrow's 9 AM board review with Mike and a couple of holiday bookings that have slipped long enough to start costing real money.

needsAttention.title: Walk into the Sunday board review ready
needsAttention.detail: Mike's 15-minute board review sits on your calendar at 9 AM tomorrow; a quick pass over the Mike + Dan board first means you arrive knowing what's active and what has slipped three Sundays running.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board task to hold a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been open since mid-September — the hardest rental in that market over the holidays, and the one where waiting actually costs money as inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: December break still undecided
needsAttention.detail: The all-girls December trip (Dec 13–Jan 2) was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15; both dates are now behind you, and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year.

flagged.title: KLA government-affairs VP role
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a VP, Global Government Affairs & Strategic Policy opening at KLA — squarely in your lane.

flagged.title: Maine directors event feedback
flagged.detail: Ellen Richstone circulated Steve Shane's candid read on the NACD Maine event; Shane also noted he has capacity for another board seat.

inbox.noise: A few newsletters, an alumni class note, and the NACD event-recording link — nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on a reply.

resolved.title: ICGN Toronto panel questions locked
resolved.detail: You signed off on Jen Sisson's reshaped stewardship session flow and Flo confirmed Rachit is now aligned on the commercial angle — closed out Oct 29.

recipe.why: Autumn's roots, squash, and apples reward a slow, warming kitchen.

Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear morning with the girls — nothing on the calendar but the day itself.
Still wide open through the afternoon — a rare empty Saturday to spend on whatever's been waiting.
Halloween with the four of them, the last night before tomorrow evening's handoff back to Jen.
